review_kind: Claude AI translation and review (Claude Opus 5.5) of the Navigator protocol assumption sentences: one declarative sentence per protocol choice (input family, data and image format, filename metadata, sequencer, read pairing and orientation, experiment, barcode mapping, organism and analysis route). No native-speaker sign-off.
